run_evaluation: run the evaluate module to evaluate RL MountainCarContinuous checkpoints and print reward metrics
load_neural_network: load a neural network model and parameters from a saved checkpoint pickle file
rollout_batch: run a batched rollout of 256 parallel MountainCarContinuous episodes using JAX JIT compilation
review_rollout_batch: review the rollout_batch function that uses jax.lax.scan to step environments and accumulate rewards
refactor_load_neural_network: refactor load_neural_network to support loading models from different checkpoint formats
